chinese_source: Lidai Sanbao Ji (Fei Changfang, 597 CE); Da Tang Neidian Lu (Daoxuan, 664)
event: Sanghabhadra, translator of the Samantapasadika, places the 975th dot of the vinaya dotted record at Canton; the count, begun by Upali at the first pavarana after the parinirvana and handed down the Theravada vinaya lineage, implies parinirvana in 486 BCE
firmness_reason: The record is real but NOT independent: its custodian chain is the Theravada vinaya lineage itself, so its 486 BCE agrees with the Ceylon 218-year chronology because both are the same tradition's arithmetic (Pachow: the count needs a 3-dot adjustment to land on 483)
notes: Campaign case 1 verdict: NO BITE as an independent correction. Carried so the tool refuses to count it as a second witness for the long chronology.
references: Daoxuan, Da Tang Neidian Lu, T.2149
Pachow, A Study of the Dotted Record
Bechert (ed.), Die Datierung des historischen Buddha
